mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_seq AS commentSeq, c.user_seq AS userSeq, u.user_name AS userName, c.board_seq AS boardSeq, c.comment_content AS commentContent, c.comment_writedate AS commentWritedate, c.comment_update AS commentUpdate FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_seq = u.user_seq WHERE c.board_seq = #{boardSeq} ORDER BY c.comment_writedate ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (user_seq, board_seq, comment_content) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{boardSeq}, #{commentContent})
